_comment: Parameters for the shared checks (tools/checks): {"<check>": {"<param>": value}}. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_accessor: store.sh is the CLI cli.json names, over BOTH stores: data/scrapers.db (the recipe DB) and data/failures.db (the failures store). Its writer verbs (register, set, verify-recipe, scrape, failures) forward to the CLIs that already write them. db.js is the one module that opens the recipe DB (DB_PATH, openDb) and failuresDb.js the one that opens the failures store (FAILURES_DB_PATH, openFailuresDb): every CLI here reads them through those, never by path. store.js and lib/storeExport.js are store.sh's own modules. .gitignore must name the files to ignore them. lib/builtinActions.js is RENDERED from the recipe DB (lib/exportBuiltins.js): a changeNote there quotes the history as written, so it is excluded rather than edited (an edit would make it differ from a fresh render). Prose elsewhere says 'the recipe DB' / 'the failures store' rather than the file name, so a real read of a file anywhere else stays a finding.
